title: TipsAudit Public Track Record — football predictions, fair odds and closing-line value
description: Daily snapshots, since 20 June 2026, of the public track record of football (soccer) 1X2 predictions published by TipsAudit, each logged before kick-off, with the sharp-market (Pinnacle) price recorded for the prediction, the devigged fair probability of the pick, the closing price, the prediction's closing-line value (raw Pinnacle price against the raw Pinnacle close, not devigged), the settled result and the value flag if there is one. Also includes a monthly CSV of the settled predictions that adds the devigged fair probabilities of all three outcomes, the best price at other bookmakers (two betting exchanges included) and the bookmaker margin on each match (columns and caveats in datasets/README.md), daily bookmaker-margin measurements (betting exchanges included) and the frozen specifications of pre-registered forward experiments. Timestamped snapshots are never overwritten; each is listed with its SHA-256 in manifest.csv and submitted to OpenTimestamps when published. A weekly upgrade adds the Bitcoin attestation to those proofs, so the newest proofs may still be pending. The Git history shows any difference between snapshots; CORRECTIONS.md describes the corrections we announced. Value flags before 26 September 2026 are a reconstruction (a backtest), not a record of what the site showed at the time (see CORRECTIONS.md).
